p: It is not near: Thus the wicked derided the prophets as though they preached only errors, and therefore gave themselves still to their pleasures.
caldron: We will not be pulled out of Jerusalem, till the hour of our death comes, as the flesh is not taken out of the caldron until it is boiled.
the flesh: Contrary to their vain confidence he shows in what sense the city is the caldron: that is, because of the dead bodies that have been murdered in it, and so lit as flesh in the caldron.
the hands of strangers: That is, of the Chaldeans.
Israel: That is, in Riblah, read 2Ki 25:6.
Benaiah died: It seems that this noble man died of some terrible death, and therefore the prophet feared some strange judgment of God toward the rest of the people.
brethren: They that remained at Jerusalem thus reproached them that were gone into captivity as though they were cast off and forsaken by God.

sanctuary in the countries where they: They will be yet a little church: showing that the Lord will ever have some to call on his Name, whom he will preserve and restore, though they are for a time afflicted.
stony heart out of their flesh: Meaning, the heart to which nothing can enter and regenerate them anew, so that their heart may be soft and ready to receive my graces.
captivity all the things that the: When Jeconiah was led away captive.
